title: Formal Safety Verification for Nonlinear Systems with Generative Barrier Certificate
summary: Safety verification is a fundamental problem in control theory. Barrier certificates (BCs) provide a powerful formal mechanism, yet deriving BCs is computationally intensive. This paper introduces a generative framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) to synthesize BCs through reasoning. Based on the classical Sum-of-Squares (SOS) approach, we train a domain-specific LLM capable of generating high-quality BC candidates for nonlinear systems.
